rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone deliberately makes something longer.

example.english: Please lengthen these trousers a little.
example.traditional: 麻煩你將條褲加長少少。
example.jyutping: maa4 faan4 nei5 zoeng1 tiu4 fu3 gaa1 coeng4 siu2 siu2

rows.note: Use this in everyday speech when something has become longer by itself or through change over time.

example.english: Lately, the days have begun to lengthen and the nights have become shorter.
example.traditional: 近排日頭長咗，夜晚短咗。
example.jyutping: gan6 paai2 jat6 tau4 coeng4 zo2 je6 maan5 dyun2 zo2
